description: This file defines the Express.js routes related to exercise logs in a health tracking backend API. It includes route handlers for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting exercise entries, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list exercise logs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new exercise log.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a specific exercise log by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an exercise log by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an exercise log by ID.
